question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I await your response.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Your response is awaited."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence **“I await your response” **is in the active voice.
 
• In this sentence, **“I” **is the subject, **“await” **is the verb, and **“your response” **is the object.
 
• When we convert an active sentence into a passive one, **the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence**.
 
• The verb is changed to a form of **"be,” **followed by the past participle of the main verb.
 
• So, in the passive voice, **“your response” **becomes the subject, **“is” **is the form of **“be”, **and **“awaited” **is the past participle of **“await”. **
 
• Hence, the correct passive form of **“I await your response” **is **“Your response is awaited”.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3". **
